reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and use it every day. I can't see what three AI 'managers' would do that my copy-pasting doesn't, so I'd try the free plan at most and wouldn't pay 99 euros a month on a hunch.
objection: "Connects to your CRM" is easy to say. Our CRM is half empty and nobody updates it, so I doubt these co-workers will know enough about my business to do anything without me checking every step, and then I'm back to doing the work myself.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own Google Workspace and CRM where it does a real job end to end, like following up stale leads and drafting the replies, and saves me hours in the first week without me babysitting it.
